newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Oct chain store sales up 7.7 pct mth/mth.
newsitem.headline: Japan Oct chain store sales up 7.7 pct mth/mth.

text.p: Sales at chain stores in Japan in October rose 7.7 percent from the previous month to 1.37 trillion yen, the Japan Chain Stores Association said on Monday.
Year on year, chain stores posted a 0.9 percent increase in October.
Sales of fresh food in October showed a meagre rise of 1.1 percent from the previous month and were down 2.5 percent from the year-earlier period, the association said in its monthly report.
Sales of men's apparel in October rose by a sharp 43.3 percent from September, while those of women's apparel increased 18.9 percent, the report said.
The report is based on a survey of 132 chain store operators in Japan.
